sources.title: Joyhub Introduces AI Feature for Creator Interactive Personas
sources.snippet: LOS ANGELES —Joyhub has introduced a new feature allowing creators to build AI-powered versions of themselves within its platform. According to the company, the feature enables creators to create personalized AI personas based on their tone, style, and preferences.
